A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 36-page versions of the same SCSI paper, including Appendices A–D. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Gaussian/AWGN simulations, two-moon experiments, image restoration and generation results, and quasar-spectrum reconstruction, with additional experiments in Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, and qualitative reconstructions in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The SCSI objectives, iterative transport procedure, truncated inner-loop optimization, and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. Appendix B.2 retains the same conditional-generation construction.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Gaussian/AWGN simulations, two-moon data, CIFAR-10, CelebA, and SDSS quasar spectra. Corruption scenarios, including JPEG extrapolation and Poisson noise in Appendix D, are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: DPS and SI-Oracle for image restoration, Ambient Diffusion and EM Posterior in Table 2, Wiener filtering for spectra, and EM in the Gaussian case study.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendices C–D retain the same preprocessing, corruption settings, conditioning information, model sizes, training budgets, metrics, and transport procedures. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The convergence simulations, inner-loop sensitivity experiment, network-size ablation, ODE/SDE comparisons, corruption-severity studies, and JPEG extrapolation analysis are retained with the same evidence.

E5.justification: Table 4 still reports mean and standard deviation over three independent runs. Figures 7 and 12 retain the same MSE uncertainty reporting over 1,000 spectra; no statistical reporting practice is added or changed.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains SCSI FIDs of 5.38 and 6.74 at masking probabilities 0.25 and 0.50, respectively; the relocated Figure 7 retains the same spectra and MSE values.

T1.justification: Theorem 9 explicitly names the existing contraction factor eta, already defined in v1 Appendix A.3, and Equation 27 labels the existing condition number chi. These are equivalent notation clarifications; assumptions, bounds, derivations, and appendix proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about learning from corrupted observations with black-box simulator access, computational efficiency, flexibility, convergence guarantees, and empirical performance.

C2.justification: The convergence qualifications, ODE/SDE tradeoffs, motion-blur difficulties, and extrapolation interpretations are unchanged. Section 2.2 makes exact distribution recovery explicit as an implication of the already-stated invertibility, without changing its substantive meaning.

D1.justification: v2 adds a source-code availability statement and repository link to the abstract. The implementation, architecture, hyperparameter, hardware, and training-time information otherwise remains unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to empirical Bayes, EM, diffusion methods, and concurrent research are unchanged. The new ICLR 2026 acceptance footnote is publication metadata.

P1.justification: Limited edits clarify the introductory inverse-problem formulation and AWGN explanation, make existing notation explicit, and add a pointer to the existing Appendix A.4 proof. Publication metadata and capitalization are updated; the section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Text reflow changes figure and table placement relative to surrounding prose, including moving Figure 7 from page 16 to page 17. Link colors also change. Figures, captions, axes, legends, and table structures otherwise remain the same.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a direct source-code access pointer absent from v1 and clarifies Theorem 9's notation and the location of an existing proof. These provide limited improvements to reproducibility documentation and readability, while the method, theoretical guarantees, and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
